discovery_actual_cost.cost_basis: not supplied: the files were given directly, so no discovery run is counted

estimator_actual_cost.cost_basis: heuristic mode makes no model call

assumptions.status: Unvalidated planning assumptions. No value or multiplier here has been compared with a real coding-worker run; confidence stays low until recorded runs calibrate them.
assumptions.token_model: turns = ceil(worker_turns * (1 + retry_fraction)). input = worker_overhead_tokens * turns + measured_context + measured_context * context_resend_fraction * (turns - 1) + (tool_response_tokens_per_turn + output_tokens_per_turn) * turns * (turns - 1) / 2. output = output_tokens_per_turn * turns + edit_output_tokens.

definitions.worker_turns: model calls the worker makes before retries
definitions.retry_fraction: extra share of turns spent redoing work after a failed attempt or test run
definitions.worker_overhead_tokens: system prompt and tool definitions sent on every turn; depends on the worker, not measured
definitions.context_resend_fraction: share of the measured starting context sent again on each later turn (1 = full history resent)
definitions.tool_response_tokens_per_turn: tool output added to the conversation per turn and resent on every later turn
definitions.output_tokens_per_turn: model output per turn including reasoning, resent as input on every later turn
definitions.edit_output_tokens: extra output for writing the change itself; 0 in heuristic mode

cache.note: No cache-hit rate is assumed: every input token is priced as uncached. A worker that uses prompt caching would pay less for input.

assumptions.reasoning: Output tokens include reasoning where the provider bills it as output; it is not counted again.

pricing.billing: Pay-per-token API list prices. A subscription plan's allowance is not API billing and is not modelled here.

measurement.label: measured selected-context tokens: a count of the selected starting context, not a prediction of total solve tokens
measurement.includes: issue text and each included file's path, separators and full contents at repository_commit: exactly the bytes hashed in input_sha256, with nothing added by Glance
measurement.note: Counted with the named encoding; the worker model's own tokenizer can count differently.

assumptions.end_to_end: discovery actual cost + estimator actual cost + solve cost estimate; discovery cost was not supplied and is not included

leak_check.scope: Checks the estimator's inputs and saved estimate. It says nothing about estimate accuracy.
